Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer creates a new Draft course with basic metadata.
column3: 1. Log in as a VERIFIED Trainer. 2. Open Trainer Dashboard > My Courses > Create New Course. 3. Enter a Course Title and Course Description. 4. Select a Category from the dropdown and an Academic Level from the dropdown. 5. Tap the upload box under Course Media and pick a thumbnail image. 6. Tap Save.
column4: Toast "Course created successfully as DRAFT!"; the new course appears in My Courses with a DRAFT badge; the thumbnail uploads to Cloudinary first and the returned secure URL is what gets saved; the server-generated code (COURSE-<timestamp> pattern) is used, not any client value, since the Create Course form has no Code field at all.
column5: Trainer role, VERIFIED profile.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: The Create/Edit Course UI only ever lets a Trainer pick ONE Category from a single dropdown, even though the backend accepts up to 3 (categoryKeys array) - there is no multi-select control anywhere in the authoring screens to test the 3-category cap through the UI.
column3: 1. On Create New Course, inspect the Category field. 2. Open Edit Course > Course Information and inspect its Category field.
column4: Both screens render Category as a single-value DropdownButtonFormField (one selection only); the request body always sends categoryKeys as a one-item list built from that single dropdown value - the max-3 rule exists only as an unreachable server-side guard from this UI.
column5: A Draft course exists for step 2.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer edits a Draft course's metadata, including overriding the suggested price with a required reason.
column3: 1. Open an existing Draft course via Edit Draft. 2. On the Introduction step, change the Description and Price (Desired) field to a value different from the "Suggested: <n>" label shown next to it. 3. Observe the new "Reason for price change (Required)" field that appears. 4. Enter a reason and tap Save.
column4: The custom price and reason are accepted and persisted (Trainer always has final say on price); the Reason field is validator-blocked (red border, required) if left blank while price differs from suggestedPrice; status remains Draft.
column5: A Draft course owned by the Trainer exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Tapping the refresh icon next to Price (Desired) re-evaluates the suggested price from current content without touching the Trainer's entered price.
column3: 1. On the Introduction step of an existing Draft course, tap the refresh/re-evaluate icon beside the price field.
column4: Toast "Price re-evaluated successfully"; the course auto-saves first, then the "Suggested: <n>" label updates to the freshly recalculated tier-based value; the Price (Desired) field itself is unchanged.
column5: A Draft course owned by the Trainer exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer adds multiple Sections to a Draft course; sections are strictly append-ordered since the Syllabus editor has no drag-and-drop reorder control.
column3: 1. Open the Draft course's Syllabus step. 2. In the "NEW SECTION" form, enter a Section Name (and optional Code/Description) and tap Add Section. 3. Repeat to add 2 more Sections. 4. Reload the page.
column4: All 3 Sections appear in the Section List in the exact order they were added, numbered 1-3; there is no drag handle or reorder gesture anywhere on the Section List - the only way to change a section's position is to delete and re-add it in the desired order.
column5: Draft course exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer adds Lessons within a Section via "Manage Lessons"; lessons are likewise append-ordered with no reorder control.
column3: 1. On a Section card, tap the "Manage Lessons" icon. 2. Tap Add Lesson, choose type Video or Text, fill in the Lesson Title, and Save. 3. Repeat for 2 more Lessons under the same Section.
column4: Lessons are created under the correct Section and listed in creation order; the lesson list paginates at 8 items but offers no drag-and-drop reordering.
column5: A Section exists within a Draft course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer authors a Text-type Lesson with Markdown content plus an optional image and PDF attachment.
column3: 1. Add a Lesson of type Text. 2. Enter Lesson Title, Learning Objectives, Estimated Time, and Markdown body content. 3. Tap the image upload box and pick an image. 4. Tap the PDF drop-zone and pick a PDF; observe the upload progress indicator and file-size label. 5. Save.
column4: The Markdown content saves as entered; the image and PDF both show an uploading state with a progress indicator, then resolve to their Cloudinary URLs once complete; the Lesson persists all fields together.
column5: A Section exists within a Draft course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer authors a Video-type Lesson.
column3: 1. Add a Lesson of type Video. 2. Enter Lesson Title, then pick/upload a video file ("Video Lecture"). 3. Save.
column4: The video lesson is created with itemType=video and the uploaded video's Cloudinary URL attached; reopening the lesson shows the same video reference.
column5: A Section exists within a Draft course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: There is no Retry affordance if a media upload is interrupted - the Trainer must manually re-pick and re-upload the file, though already-typed text fields in the same form are preserved client-side.
column3: 1. Start uploading an image/PDF/video on a Lesson form. 2. Simulate a network interruption mid-upload. 3. Restore connectivity.
column4: The upload simply stalls/fails with no automatic recovery and no "Retry" button anywhere in create_lesson_text_page/create_lesson_video_page; the Trainer must tap the upload box again to re-select and re-upload the file; text fields already typed in the same still-open form are not lost since they live in local TextEditingControllers.
column5: A Lesson editor session is open with at least one text field already entered.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer attaches a Quiz to a Lesson using questions picked from their own Question Bank.
column3: 1. On a Section, tap Add Lesson and choose type Quiz (or open an existing Lesson's quiz editor). 2. Tap "Add from Question Bank". 3. Pick several existing SingleChoice questions. 4. Tap Save / Save Changes.
column4: The Quiz is created and linked to the Lesson with the selected question IDs; reopening the Lesson's quiz shows the same questions attached (Quiz questions remain reusable elsewhere, unlike Exam questions).
column5: Trainer has at least 3 questions already in their Question Bank; a Lesson exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Submitting a course with no Section/Lesson content at all is blocked.
column3: 1. Create a brand-new Draft course with only Introduction metadata filled in, no Sections added on the Syllabus step. 2. Attempt "Submit for Review" from the Progress Overview card.
column4: Submission is blocked with a validation/error toast requiring at least one Section and Lesson before review can start.
column5: A Draft course exists with an empty syllabus.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer bulk-imports Sections/Lessons/Quiz content via the Excel template, available from both the Trainer's My Courses page and the Course Manager's Courses page.
column3: 1. On Trainer Dashboard > My Courses, tap "Download Template" to get `Hango_Course_Import_Template.xlsx`. 2. Fill in a few valid rows of Sections/Lessons (and Questions if desired). 3. Tap "Import Excel" and pick the filled file.
column4: An "Import Successful" dialog reports importedCourses/importedSections/importedLessons counts; the resulting course appears in My Courses as a new DRAFT regardless of any Status cell in the sheet.
column5: Logged in as an eligible authoring role (Trainer or Course Manager with MANAGE_OWN_COURSES); a filled copy of the template is ready.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Importing an Excel file with a row missing a required field, or referencing a non-existent Question Bank question ID, surfaces a warnings list in the result dialog instead of a hard failure.
column3: 1. Prepare a copy of the template with one row missing a required field (e.g. empty Lesson title) and one Quiz row pointing at a question ID that doesn't exist. 2. Import it via "Import Excel".
column4: The "Import Successful" dialog's warnings[] list names the specific bad row/question reference; the remaining valid rows still import (partial-success, not a rollback) - the frontend surfaces exactly the warnings[] array the backend returns, unfiltered.
column5: A Draft-course-eligible account is logged in.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Trainer submits a fully-built Draft course for Course Manager review.
column3: 1. Ensure the course has at least one Section and Lesson (from TC05-TC10). 2. Open Edit Course; the left panel shows a Progress Overview card (only rendered while status=DRAFT) with a "Submit for Review" button. 3. Tap it.
column4: Toast "Course submitted for review successfully!"; status changes from Draft to Pending Approval; the course now shows a blue "Pending Approval" badge in My Courses instead of the yellow Draft badge; it appears in the Course Manager's Courses > Pending review queue.
column5: A Draft course with at least one Section and Lesson.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: A Trainer whose profile is not yet VERIFIED gets a friendly bilingual warning dialog instead of a raw error when Submit fails the verification precondition.
column3: 1. As a Trainer whose TrainerProfile.status is not VERIFIED, tap "Submit for Review" on an owned Draft course.
column4: The submit call fails server-side; the frontend detects the Vietnamese "phê duyệt"/"hoàn thiện" substrings in the error and shows a dedicated "Yêu cầu phê duyệt" (Approval required) popup instead of a generic error toast; status remains Draft.
column5: Trainer account whose profile is not VERIFIED; an owned Draft course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: A course creator who ALSO holds COURSE_MANAGER or ADMINISTRATOR self-publishes immediately on Submit, completely bypassing review - the UI shows the identical success toast either way, giving no visual indication which outcome occurred (highest-priority gap in this workflow).
column3: 1. As a user holding TRAINER + COURSE_MANAGER (or ADMINISTRATOR), create and build out a Draft course under their own account. 2. Tap "Submit for Review".
column4: The SAME "Course submitted for review successfully!" toast appears as TC14, but re-opening My Courses shows the course already PUBLISHED with no Pending Approval step and no entry ever appearing in anyone's review queue - only checking the actual status badge reveals what really happened.
column5: Caller's account holds both an authoring role and COURSE_MANAGER/ADMINISTRATOR, and is the creator of the target course.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: There is no direct-publish button anywhere in the Trainer-facing UI - "Submit for Review" is the only lifecycle action a plain Trainer has, even though the backend's legacy trainer-publish endpoint (`/trainer/courses/{id}/publish`) has no status precondition at all if called directly.
column3: 1. As a plain Trainer (no COURSE_MANAGER/ADMINISTRATOR), inspect every action available on a Draft course card in My Courses and on the Edit Course screen.
column4: Only "Submit for Review" (Draft), "Continue Editing"/"Cancel Draft" (Has-Draft), and "Edit"/"Version History" (Live) actions exist; no button anywhere calls the direct-publish endpoint - a plain Trainer can only reach Published status through the Course Manager review queue.
column5: Plain Trainer logged in; owns courses in various states.

Workflow: Course Manager Review Dashboard (single real path)

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Course Manager opens a Pending course's review detail and cannot Publish until every lesson has actually been opened at least once.
column3: 1. Log in as COURSE_MANAGER/ADMINISTRATOR. 2. Open Course Manager Dashboard > Courses, Pending tab. 3. Tap the Submitted course from TC14 to open its review dialog. 4. Without opening every lesson in the syllabus list, check the "Publish Course" button.
column4: The "Publish Course" button stays disabled (onPressed=null) until _hasViewedAll becomes true, i.e. until the Course Manager has clicked into every single lesson in the left-pane syllabus at least once; "Reject" is available immediately without this restriction.
column5: A Submitted (PENDING_APPROVAL) course with 2+ lessons exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Course Manager publishes a Submitted course once all its lessons have been reviewed.
column3: 1. Continuing from TC18, open every remaining unviewed lesson in the syllabus list. 2. Tap the now-enabled "Publish Course" button and confirm "Publish" in the confirmation dialog.
column4: Toast "Course published successfully."; status becomes PUBLISHED; the Trainer receives a ContentApproved-style notification; the course leaves the Pending queue and moves to the Published tab.
column5: All lessons of the Pending course from TC18 have been opened.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Course Manager rejects a Submitted course with a required reason, returning it to Draft.
column3: 1. Submit a second fresh Draft course (repeat TC14). 2. As Course Manager, open its review dialog. 3. Tap "Reject", type a reason in the Rejection Reason box, and confirm "Return" in the confirmation dialog.
column4: Confirmation dialog echoes the entered reason; toast "Course returned to draft."; the course's status returns to DRAFT/REJECTED with the reason visible to the Trainer (red "Rejected: <reason>" banner on the course card in My Courses); the Trainer is notified.
column5: A freshly Submitted course exists (not reused from TC18/TC19).

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Course Manager hides a Published course and later unhides it, both from the same review dashboard.
column3: 1. Open the Published course from TC19 in the review dialog. 2. Tap "Hide Course" and confirm. 3. Reopen it and tap "Unhide Course" (labelled "Unhide & Publish" in the confirmation) and confirm.
column4: Step 2: toast "Course hidden successfully."; status becomes HIDDEN; the confirmation dialog explicitly notes already-enrolled learners keep access via My Courses even while hidden from the marketplace. Step 3: toast "Course unhidden and published successfully."; status returns to PUBLISHED regardless of whether it was HIDDEN or ARCHIVED beforehand.
column5: A Published course exists (from TC19).

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: A Published course appears in the public catalog and is viewable without logging in; Draft/Pending/Rejected/Hidden courses never do.
column3: 1. Log out (or use a private/incognito session). 2. Open the course catalog. 3. Search for the Published course from TC19, then separately search for the titles of the Draft course from TC03, the Pending course from TC20 (now back to Draft), and the Hidden course mid-way through TC21.
column4: Only the Published course appears in results and opens its detail page; none of the Draft/Pending/Rejected/Hidden titles appear anywhere in public search results.
column5: Courses in each of these states exist from earlier cases.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Editing an already-Published course with existing enrollments creates a new Draft version instead of modifying the live version in place.
column3: 1. Open a Published course (with an enrolled Learner) as its Trainer via "Edit / Create New Version". 2. Change the Description and Save.
column4: Toast "A new draft has been created. You are now editing the draft."; the course card now shows the HAS_DRAFT state with both a green "PUBLISHED" badge and a yellow "Editing Draft" badge; the previously live version keeps serving enrolled Learners completely unchanged in the meantime.
column5: A Published course with at least one enrolled Learner exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: Publishing the new Draft version (via TC14/TC18-19 repeated on this version) switches the live pointer; every Learner enrolled in the prior version is notified.
column3: 1. Take the new Draft version from TC23 through Submit -> Course Manager Publish. 2. Re-check the course's Version History modal and the enrolled Learner's notification bell.
column4: The live pointer switches to the new version; the previously-live version becomes Archived, visible in Version History; every Learner enrolled in the prior version receives a CourseUpdated-style notification.
column5: The new Draft version from TC23 exists.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: A Learner already enrolled sees the old content uninterrupted until the new version is actually published.
column3: 1. As the Learner enrolled before TC23, open the course's lesson content while the new Draft version is still under review (between TC23 and TC24 completing). 2. Reopen the same lesson after TC24 completes.
column4: Before publish: the Learner still sees the original, unedited content with no disruption. After publish: the Learner now sees the updated content.
column5: Learner enrolled before the new Draft version was created in TC23.

Course Authoring- Content Building & Pub: The Course Manager Dashboard's platform course counts undercount courses awaiting review, because inactiveCoursesCount queries the literal status string "PENDING" instead of the real "PENDING_APPROVAL" value Submit actually sets (confirmed likely bug); separately, the Trainer's own My Courses status-count badges (All/Draft/Published/Hidden/Pending/Rejected) stay unfiltered even when the visible list is filtered.
column3: 1. As COURSE_MANAGER, open Course Manager Dashboard and note registeredUsersCount/activeCoursesCount/inactiveCoursesCount before and after submitting a fresh Draft course for review (status becomes PENDING_APPROVAL). 2. As the Trainer, open My Courses, filter the status tabs to "Draft" with an unrelated search keyword typed in, and inspect the count badges on the All/Draft/Published/Hidden/Pending/Rejected tabs themselves.
column4: 1. inactiveCoursesCount does NOT increase after the submission - the course sitting in PENDING_APPROVAL is silently excluded, since no course is ever persisted with the literal status "PENDING" the dashboard query actually filters on. 2. The tab count badges reflect the Trainer's FULL, unfiltered course set and do not shrink to match the narrow status/search filter, while the course cards actually shown below ARE correctly filtered.
column5: COURSE_MANAGER logged in with a DRAFT course ready to submit; Trainer with courses across >=3 different statuses.
